editorial.headline: Management Consultancy: Open Nationally, Closed to PMA in Bali
editorial.standfirst: Broad management advice is nationally open to full foreign ownership, yet Bali’s recorded rule closes PMA registration for the activity.
editorial.body:
Management consultancy under KBLI 70209 is a broad operating-advice category: it covers helping a business work through strategy and organisation, finance-related decisions, planning goals and policies, human-resources practices, and production scheduling and control. Its centre of gravity is not simply recommendations on paper, but advice, guidance and practical operational assistance on management functions and organisational problems. The scope reaches specialist work as well: agriculture-related management advice, the design of accounting methods and procedures, cost-accounting programmes, budget-control procedures, management information, and assistance to businesses and public services on planning, organisation, efficiency and supervision.

The brief also expressly takes in occupational health and safety consultancy, including risk identification and documentation, along with infrastructure investment study services and port-security management consultancy. It also encompasses advice and assistance concerned with the planning, organising, efficiency and supervision of business and public-service activity. That range matters because the activity is defined by the business and management problem being addressed, rather than by a single industry setting. For a founder, the stated scope is the important boundary: it brings together connected management work across multiple functions while remaining advice, guidance and operational assistance.

Nationally, the classification is open to PMA and permits up to 100% foreign ownership. It is open at the Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar scales, so the register itself does not reserve it to one size of enterprise. Those two points are important, but they are not the whole registration answer for someone choosing Bali. National openness does not translate into PMA registration availability in Bali for this activity.

Bali’s recorded status is CHIUSO_BALI: management consultancy has been closed to PMA registration there since January 2026, as the first of seven announced sectoral closures. The provincial setting is stricter still: Bali applies an island-wide, permanent moratorium blocking PMA registration for all low- and medium-low-risk KBLI activities. For a foreign investor, the practical conclusion is plain: even though full foreign ownership is available nationally, this activity cannot be registered through PMA in Bali under the recorded Bali rule.
